source_a_description: Original ground-truth bounding-box annotations for the 55-plate validation set
source_b_description: Phase 5I segmentation validation annotations across the 55-plate validation set
reason: During the Phase 5H proof-of-concept study (scripts/generate_colony_pseudo_masks.py), MobileSAM pseudo-masks were generated for 3 representative validation plates (sp06_img30, sp10_img20, sp13_img04) containing 1,300 candidate bounding boxes. The quality filter rejected 16 low-quality masks (2 in sp06_img30, 13 in sp10_img20, 1 in sp13_img04), accepting 1,284 masks. When the Phase 5I segmentation dataset (ml-data/colony-segmentation-phase5i/labels/val) was assembled, these 3 plates retained their Phase 5H accepted pseudo-masks (1,284 instances) while the remaining 52 plates converted bounding boxes to 4-vertex rectangular polygons (6,724 instances), yielding exactly 8,008 instances (8,024 - 16 = 8,008). Ultralytics validation of YOLO11n-seg during training evaluated against the 8,008 annotations in colony-segmentation-phase5i/labels/val, whereas detector evaluation evaluated against the 8,024 annotations in processed_yolo/labels/val.

sp06_img30.cause: 2 candidate masks rejected by Phase 5H MobileSAM quality filtering

sp10_img20.cause: 13 candidate masks rejected by Phase 5H MobileSAM quality filtering

sp13_img04.cause: 1 candidate mask rejected by Phase 5H MobileSAM quality filtering

other_52_plates.cause: Exact 1-to-1 match (all boxes converted to 4-vertex rectangles)
